messages.subject: Project Skylark - Licence Agreement v1 for your review
messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair,

First draft of the Patent and Technology Licence Agreement is in the data room (Project_Skylark_LicenceAgreement_v1). Key terms per the heads: £5m upfront, 4.5% royalty (3.0% after £15m cumulative), £1.5m/£2.0m milestones, £1m annual minimum, £10m cap. Look forward to your mark-up.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Skylark - Licence Agreement v2 (our mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our redline (v2) is attached. The commercial team can't go to £5m upfront - we've marked it to £4.5m. We've also brought the royalty step-down threshold down to £12m, the annual minimum to £750k, and the overall liability cap to £6m. The royalty rates themselves are fine. Warranty qualifications still to discuss.

Alistair Whitlock
Partner, Pemberton Rowe LLP
